questions.scenario: An accounts payable team receives supplier invoices in hundreds of different layouts. The team needs the vendor name, invoice date and invoice total from each invoice without training a model.
questions.question: What should the team use?

options.text: The prebuilt-invoice analyzer in Azure Content Understanding
options.why: Correct. prebuilt-invoice returns standard invoice fields across varied layouts with no training.
prebuilt-read returns text only and does not identify invoice fields.
gpt-image-1 generates images and does not extract fields.
Speech services process audio, not documents.

questions.explanation: The prebuilt-invoice analyzer is designed to extract standard invoice fields from many layouts without custom training.

questions.question: You create a custom Content Understanding analyzer for purchase orders. The PO number is printed on every document. Which field extraction method should you use for the PONumber field?

options.why: Correct. Extract returns a value that appears in the document.
Classify selects a value from a predefined list of categories.
Generate creates new values, such as summaries, and is not intended for copying printed values.
Segmentation splits content into parts and is not a field method.

questions.explanation: The extract method returns values that are present in the document, such as a printed purchase order number.

questions.question: Which TWO pieces of information does Content Understanding return with an extracted field value to support human review?

options.why: Correct. The confidence score indicates how certain the service is about the value.

options.text: Grounding that identifies where the value was found in the source
options.why: Correct. Grounding lets a reviewer locate the value in the original document.
Temperature is a model generation parameter, not part of field results.
Content credentials are attached to generated images, not extracted fields.

questions.explanation: Each field includes a confidence score and grounding information, which together help decide and support human review.

questions.question: A legal team wants each contract tagged as NDA, Service agreement or Lease. Which field method should the custom analyzer use?

options.why: The contract type is usually not printed as a single value to copy.
Correct. Classify assigns one value from a defined list of categories.
Generate produces free-form values. A fixed list of categories is better handled by classify.
prebuilt-read is an analyzer for OCR, not a field method.

questions.explanation: When a field must contain one of a fixed set of values, use the classify method.

questions.question: You try to run a prebuilt Content Understanding analyzer on a new Foundry resource and the request fails. What must be configured on the resource before analyzers can run?

options.text: A virtual network with a private endpoint
options.why: Private networking is optional and not required to run analyzers.

options.text: Default model deployments used by Content Understanding
options.why: Correct. Content Understanding uses configured model deployments, such as a completion model and an embedding model.

options.text: A Speech resource in the same region
options.why: A separate Speech resource is not required for document analysis.

options.text: An agent with a file search tool
options.why: Agents are not required to use Content Understanding analyzers.

questions.explanation: Content Understanding relies on generative model deployments, so default model deployments must be set on the Foundry resource.
